set_pag_applied_layers: set PAG attention layers on a diffusers pipeline using layer name patterns or regex
_set_pag_attn_processor: apply PAG attention processors to self-attention layers in a UNet or transformer model
_apply_perturbed_attention_guidance: apply perturbed attention guidance to noise predictions during diffusion inference
_prepare_perturbed_attention_guidance: prepare conditional and unconditional tensors for perturbed attention guidance
pag_attn_processors: inspect which PAG attention processors are currently active on the denoiser model
